caption: The drawing features a round, dark-colored object with a geometric, lattice-like pattern in the center, composed of raised interlocking shapes forming star and polygon motifs. The outer edge of the object is bordered by a twisted rope-like design. The drawing is executed in a grayscale palette, with shading used to indicate depth and form. Above the main object, there is a detailed top view of the object showing the full pattern, as well as a side view with four short legs and a scale for reference. The object appears to be metallic and is depicted with a high degree of precision. The background is a plain, light color. In the bottom left corner, there is a handwritten name: "Joseph Rothenberg."
title: Trivet
